d: Senator Elissa Slotkin delivers a blunt warning to Democrats after their midterm victory, declaring that America's biggest existential threat is not a foreign adversary but the economic crisis crushing its middle class. Calling for bold action on healthcare, housing and prescription drug costs, Slotkin urges Democrats to unite behind a new generation of leadership, hold those who abused taxpayer money accountable and prevent another Trump-style presidency from exploiting the government.
